name: Payment Terms 6
definition: Specifies the payment terms of the underlying transaction.

DueDate.name: Due Date
DueDate.definition: Due date specified for the payment terms.

PaymentPeriod.name: Payment Period
PaymentPeriod.definition: Payment period specified for these payment terms.

Description.name: Description
Description.definition: Textual description of these payment terms.

PartialPaymentPercent.name: Partial Payment Percent
PartialPaymentPercent.definition: Partial payment, expressed as a percentage, for the payment terms.

DirectDebitMandateIdentification.name: Direct Debit Mandate Identification
DirectDebitMandateIdentification.definition: Direct debit mandate identification specified for these payment terms.

BasisAmount.name: Basis Amount
BasisAmount.definition: Amount used as a basis to calculate the discount amount for these payment terms.

DiscountAmount.name: Discount Amount
DiscountAmount.definition: Amount of money that results from the application of an agreed discount percentage to the basis amount and payable to the creditor.

DiscountPercentRate.name: Discount Percent Rate
DiscountPercentRate.definition: Percent rate used to calculate the discount for these payment terms.

PenaltyAmount.name: Penalty Amount
PenaltyAmount.definition: Amount of money that results from the application of an agreed penalty percentage to the basis amount and payable by the creditor.

PenaltyPercentRate.name: Penalty Percent Rate
PenaltyPercentRate.definition: Percent rate used to calculate the penalty for these payment terms.
